instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat an 8-inch cake pan with cooking spray.
Place sugar, cocoa powder, cold brew coffee concentrate, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large mixing bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup granulated sugar
½ cup cocoa powder
¼ cup cold brew coffee concentrate
¾ tsp baking powder
¼ tsp baking soda
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add oil, sour cream, and egg to the bowl with the sugar mixture, then whisk to combine. Add flour and whisk once more until the batter is just combined. Pour batter into the prepared cake pan.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup neutral vegetable oil
⅓ cup sour cream
1 egg
⅔ cup all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Place pan in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 25-35 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool completely.

Once the cake is cool, heat cream in a small saucepan set over medium heat until starting to steam, about 1 minute. Remove from heat, add chocolate hazelnut spread and salt to the pan, then stir until the chocolate cream is smooth and combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup heavy whipping cream
½ cup chocolate hazelnut spread
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Pour chocolate cream over the cooled cake, spreading it out in an even layer.
Fill a clean small saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
Place additional chocolate hazelnut spread and chocolate chips in a medium heat-proof bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup chocolate hazelnut spread
¼ cup semi-sweet chocolate chips

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, uncover the pan and place the bowl with the chocolate hazelnut spread and chocolate chips over the simmering water, allowing it to sit on the rim. Using a silicone spatula, stir continuously, until just melted and smooth. Remove from heat, add corn flake cereal and hazelnuts, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups corn flakes cereal
⅓ cup hazelnuts, chopped

instructions.primary_message: Spoon chocolate cereal over the cake, spreading it out in an even layer. Let topping set, about 20 minutes.
To serve, "spoon" cake into bowls and enjoy!
